_readme: Prices the repo does not hold. Every value is null until the operator reads the named page and writes the figure with the date it was read. A filled model entry: { "inputPerMTok": n, "cachedInputPerMTok": n or null, "cacheWritePerMTok": n or null, "outputPerMTok": n, "source": "<the page's URL>", "readOn": "YYYY-MM-DD" } (USD per 1M tokens; a null cached rate bills cached tokens at the full input rate). A filled image entry: { "usdPerImage": n, "source": "<URL>", "readOn": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. A judgement ceiling: { "usd": n, "derivation": "<the arithmetic, from the prices above>" }.

images._where: fal's model pages: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/flux-2-pro/edit and https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/bytedance/seedream/v4/edit . Seedream conflicts in the repo (docs/ASTRA_SETS.md says $0.03; angle-stage-config.ts says fal publishes no price): re-read the page before the run.

judgementCeilings._where: Optional. The most one judgement can cost, derived from the model prices above (e.g. the prompt gate: up to 2 reads, 5 at an edge). Without one, gate spend is metered, not reserved.
